title: English-Vietnamese construction project management glossary
desc: Look up 170+ English-Vietnamese terms: project management, cost estimating, FIDIC, tendering, QA/QC, safety, programme, BIM, with links to Vietnamese legal definitions.
summary: An English-Vietnamese glossary for engineers, QS, QA/QC and supervision staff, with a search box and links to legal definitions where available.
lead: Type in English or Vietnamese to look up a term; terms defined in law link to the exact article.
body: Project records, FIDIC contracts and reports from foreign consultants use many English terms. This page gathers commonly encountered terms, grouped into 10 categories: project management, cost - QS, contracts, tendering, design - documentation, quality - QA/QC, safety - environment, programme, BIM, and operation - maintenance. Type the term you want into the search box or choose a category to filter.

The definitions were compiled by Quan Construction for reference. Terms marked “According to …” have been checked against definitions in legal documents (Construction Law 2025, Bidding Law 2023 - partially no longer in force, Decrees 207, 210, 212 and 217/2026); where there is a difference, apply the legal document itself. International contract terminology (FIDIC) is used as agreed in each contract.
